# Operational-origin backtest: NYISO N.Y.C. day-ahead price (generated by scripts/evaluate_operational.py)

**Question.** Using only information available at 05:00 ET on day D (see `docs/operational-timing.md`), does any model beat the baseline of repeating the price of day D, so that it deserves to serve forecasts?

**Setup.** Features OB/OD exclude day-D load and observed temperature. Weather = GFS 48-hour-lead forecast (Open-Meteo `previous_day2`). Hyperparameters chosen on 2022 only with these features ({'OB': {'max_depth': 4, 'n_estimators': 300}, 'OD': {'max_depth': 4, 'n_estimators': 300}}). 23 days (2023-12-29 to 2024-01-20) have a missing forecast hour and are excluded for every model; 709 days / 17,004 hourly points remain. Nothing is imputed.

**Serving rule (fixed before the run):** eligible iff, vs the baseline on the common days: (1) 95% block-bootstrap CI of the daily MAE difference is entirely < 0, (2) Diebold-Mariano p < 0.05, (3) mean daily MAE difference < 0 in every calendar year of the test window. If no model is eligible the system serves the baseline.

**Limits.** One zone, one weather point, GFS only, one 2-year window. The live forecast available at the origin is related to, but not identical with, the archived 48-hour-lead proxy. A retrospective backtest, not a trading result.

## Overall (identical points for all models)

| model | MAE ($/MWh) | RMSE | bias | rMAE vs baseline |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline: same hour of day D [reference] | 5.78 | 13.14 | +0.17 | 1.000 |
| XGBoost OB (prices, calendar, load through D-1), no weather | 5.71 | 12.58 | +1.19 | 0.987 |
| XGBoost OB, trained on the same dates as the forecast-trained model [control] | 6.09 | 13.09 | +1.69 | 1.052 |
| XGBoost OD (+ forecast temp, 48 h lead), (a) trained on actual temp | 4.84 | 10.62 | +0.11 | 0.837 |
| XGBoost OD (+ forecast temp, 48 h lead), (b) trained on forecasts | 5.45 | 10.76 | +1.88 | 0.942 |

## Difference vs baseline (daily mean absolute error; negative = better than baseline)

| model | mean diff | 95% block-bootstrap CI | DM p | 2023 | 2024 | eligible to serve |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| XGBoost OB (prices, calendar, load through D-1), no weather | -0.070 | [-0.609, +0.612] | 0.823 | +0.261 | -0.419 | **no** |
| XGBoost OB, trained on the same dates as the forecast-trained model [control] | +0.304 | [-0.316, +1.074] | 0.404 | +0.915 | -0.337 | **no** |
| XGBoost OD (+ forecast temp, 48 h lead), (a) trained on actual temp | -0.939 | [-1.356, -0.562] | 2.94e-06 | -0.946 | -0.931 | **yes** |
| XGBoost OD (+ forecast temp, 48 h lead), (b) trained on forecasts | -0.329 | [-0.905, +0.225] | 0.247 | -0.133 | -0.534 | **no** |

**Decision:** serving candidate = `xgb_OD_train_actual`; eligible = ['xgb_OD_train_actual']. If none: serve the baseline (same hour of day D).
